module: Node "Boost Vehicle" (category `repeat_p_duration`, tags boost/thrust). Loads the vehicle extension `core_booster` then calls `core_booster.boost({power,0,0}, dtSim)` every frame. Input pins: `vehId`, `power` (number). Marked `obsolete` in the code ("unknown status, try Apply Velocity").
notes: `C.todo`: the author does not know whether the node works. `C.obsolete` points to the Apply Velocity node.
No `veh == nil` test: crashes if no vehicle is found (the player fallback can also give nil).
The boost vector is {power, 0, 0}: the power is applied only on the X axis (presumed vehicle frame).

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (returned by `_flowgraph_createNode(C)`). Definition fields: name, description, category, pinSchema, tags.

_executionStopped.desc: Resets `loaded = false` to reload `core_booster` at the next start.

init.desc: Constructor; `loaded = false` (the extension is not yet loaded on the vehicle side).

work.desc: Loads `core_booster` in the vehicle VM the first time, then sends `core_booster.boost({power,0,0}, dtSim)` every frame.
